standard.title: Standard dense pretraining
standard.what: Every weight of a dense decoder trained by backpropagation, its optimizer outside the token blocks.

dials.name: n_params
dials.why: the trained model; d_model and n_layer follow at the reference model's d/L (te_core.workloads.dense)

dials.name: precision
dials.why: the weight GEMMs' format, forward and backward; attention stays bf16

dials.name: seq_len
dials.why: the training context: each token's attention span

dials.name: batch_tokens
dials.why: sets the optimizer's share, 1 - sigma; the pilot's 64 x 1,024

dials.name: optimizer
dials.why: sets Delta_grad (the state) and the optimizer's gates

dials.name: t
dials.unit: share of a token's affected work
dials.why: A1's free share: None is te_core's literal t on the 45M trace, 0.692646; 0 is evenly spread

dials.name: tokens_per_param
dials.why: sets |C| only (Chinchilla's 20 by default)

45M ref-optim/adamw-rewarm-mild.differs: w 0.9% below the model's; u(1) the fp32 embedding with the bf16 matrices, 25 bits a parameter; u_in all of it at x = 0; Delta the submitted code, 32 N

45M ref-optim/cooldown-forks.source: te_core 4.1's console columns for the record (algorithm_policy, quantities measured, t literal; 4.2 refuses the trace, made before its capture listed read-backs, until the run is traced again); delta_grad_bits its trace's gradient cut and state; u_in_points the trace's u_in at the policies' k
45M ref-optim/cooldown-forks.differs: as adamw-rewarm-mild; sigma the trace's 0.99339 against the model's 0.98774, five bf16 Newton-Schulz iterations on every matrix

diloco.title: DiLoCo-style pretraining
diloco.what: Standard training on workers that sync every H inner steps by an outer step on their pseudo-gradients, optionally compressed.

dials.name: n_params
dials.why: the inner model, which every worker trains; d_model and n_layer follow (te_core.workloads.dense)

dials.name: precision
dials.why: the weight GEMMs' format, forward and backward; attention stays bf16

dials.name: seq_len
dials.why: the training context: each token's attention span

dials.name: batch_tokens
dials.why: B, an inner step's tokens, all workers

dials.name: optimizer
dials.why: sets Delta_grad (the state) and the optimizer's gates

dials.name: t
dials.unit: share of a token's affected work
dials.why: A1's free share: None is te_core's literal t on the 45M trace, 0.692646; 0 is evenly spread

dials.name: inner_steps
dials.why: H, the inner steps between syncs

dials.name: syncs
dials.why: S, the record's outer steps so far; its tokens are S H B (28: 20 a parameter at 45M)

dials.name: sync_bits
dials.why: b, one compressed outer delta; None is 32 N, uncompressed
